en.headline: V Mart creative market continues at Victoria Park through November
en.dek: The free cultural and creative arts market runs on weekends and public holidays in Victoria Park until 29 November as part of a check-in campaign with Windsor House.
body: A cultural and creative arts market called V Mart is operating in Victoria Park on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays from 1 to 29 November.

The market forms part of Windsor House's check-in campaign. Visitors who check in at the market and share on social media with specified hashtags can collect a HK$50 e-coupon at Windsor House, usable against a minimum spend at participating merchants, while stocks last.

The organisers said the market offers stalls with cultural and creative items. It is open to the public free of charge during its operating days. Details of exact daily hours were not specified in the announcement, but the campaign runs through the end of the month.
Victoria Park is accessible via Causeway Bay or Tin Hau MTR stations. The market is one of several park activities linked to the nearby shopping centre's promotion.

zh.headline: 維園V Mart文創市集周末及假日繼續 至11月底
zh.dek: 維多利亞公園的免費文化創意市集於11月1日至29日期間的周六、日及公眾假期舉行，屬皇室堡打卡有禮活動一部分。
body: 名為V Mart的文化創意藝術市集正於維多利亞公園舉行，時間為11月1日至29日的周六、日及公眾假期。
市集屬皇室堡「維園打卡有禮」活動一部分。市民到市集打卡並在社交媒體分享指定標籤，可到皇室堡領取50元電子優惠券，於指定商戶消費滿額使用，數量有限，先到先得。
主辦方表示市集設有文化創意攤檔，免費開放予公眾。公告未詳細列明每日確切開放時間，但活動持續至月底。
維園可由港鐵銅鑼灣站或天后站前往。市集是附近商場推廣活動中的公園活動之一。
